key.name: workspace
key.description: JSON document: projects contain lists, lists contain todos. Empty on first run.

key.name: open-organizedtodo
key.description: Press Alt+Shift+Space to open the extension.

key.name: quick-add
key.summary: Shortcut to quickly add a task
key.description: Press Super+Alt+T to add a task from anywhere, without opening the menu.

key.name: quick-add-destination
key.summary: Last project and list used by quick add
key.description: Project id and list id where the last quick-added task went. Empty until the first use.

key.name: theme
key.description: organizedtodo: dark, with the purple of the panel icon. system: follows GNOME's light/dark style and accent color.

key.name: panel-position
key.summary: Where the icon sits in the top bar

key.name: show-pending-count
key.summary: Show the number of pending tasks next to the icon

key.name: menu-height
key.summary: Maximum height of the task area, in pixels

key.name: completion-effect
key.summary: Pulse and burst of dots when a task is marked done

key.name: open-on
key.summary: Screen shown when the menu opens
key.description: last: where it was left. projects: always the Projects screen, except while a notes draft is being edited.

key.name: confirm-delete
key.summary: Ask for a second click before deleting a project or list that is not empty

key.name: quick-add-keep-open
key.summary: Keep the quick add open after adding a task

key.name: new-todo-position
key.summary: Where a new task goes in its list
key.description: top: first, but below the focused task, which always stays first.

key.name: done-todo-position
key.summary: What happens to a task marked done
key.description: bottom: it moves to the end of its list and loses the focus. Unchecking leaves it there.

key.name: project-completion
key.summary: What happens when every task of a project is done
key.description: button: the project shows a Complete button. automatic: the project is archived in Completed at once.

key.name: quick-add-target
key.summary: Where quick add puts a task
key.description: remember: the list used last. ask: the dialog opens on the project and list picker every time.
